alternatives.description: Project one affine response with existing Gaussian backend; integrate H3/H4 analytically with exact prior Jacobians and an injected stable log quadratic-window function. H5 uses bounded one-dimensional positive quadrature after scaling.
alternatives.tradeoff: Requires declared accuracy of the injected special/quadrature functions; engineering estimates allowed without physical uniform certificate.

alternatives.description: Direct quadrature in original beta,s,rd coordinates using the same already computed background and backend.
alternatives.tradeoff: Avoids coordinate Jacobians if original priors retained, but uses more conditional likelihood evaluations. No new CAMB calls; not an automatic retry when A fails.

alternatives.description: Subtract two ordinary normal CDF floats after completing the square.
alternatives.tradeoff: Can falsely return zero in tails or catastrophically cancel prefactor and tail. Not the selected implementation.
